description: Pixel programs admitted by the material capture path (docs/MATERIAL_PS2X_CONTRACT.md, docs/MATERIAL_FAMILY_CONTRACTS.md). Each is identified by exact bytecode SHA-256. 'rows' are the pixel-shader constant registers the program reads, in capture order; the payload declares them beside the constant blob. 'samplers' lists the texture slots the program binds, in capture order, with the D3D resource type (3 = D3DRTYPE_TEXTURE, 4 = D3DRTYPE_CUBETEXTURE). src/shader/pixel_material.inc and the replay fixture mirror this table; tests/verify_pixel_program_table.py keeps all descriptions identical. Program bytes are captured game content and stay local; this schema carries digests only.
